hypotheses.persona: Office worker who works from home part of the week
hypotheses.rationale: The weekday routine shows a structured schedule with morning coffee preparation, desk activity during typical work hours, and evening meal patterns. The absence of laptop observation on Friday and different weekend timing (keys at counter at 11:51 instead of morning departure) suggests a regular work week with different weekend patterns.
The structured routine could fit a student, but the weekend behavior (later morning, different meal timing) doesn't strongly support this hypothesis.
The structured routine could fit, but the timing of activities during typical work hours and different weekend patterns make this unlikely.
